```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
#install.packages("suncalc")
#install.packages("lutz")
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(suncalc)
library(lutz)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}

vfiles <- list.files("../Data/raw/New Orleans/OneDrive_2_7-22-2026", full.names = TRUE)

dfcalls_list <- vector("list", length(vfiles)) 

# Reads each file and appends it to a list (which is efficient) 

for(X in seq_along(vfiles)){

  dftemp <- fread(vfiles[X], check.names = TRUE) %>% 
   rename_all(tolower) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>% 
    select(-starts_with("v")) 
  
  if(grepl("Weekly", vfiles[X])){ 
    dftemp <- dftemp %>% 
      rename(dateend = date) 
  } 
  dfcalls_list[[X]] <- dftemp 
} 


dfcalls_list <- bind_rows(dfcalls_list) 

rm(dftemp, X, vfiles); gc() 

#Bind all the elements of the list into a single data frame. 

calls <- bind_rows(dfcalls_list) 

```


```{r, include = FALSE}
names(calls) [8] <- "response_datetime" 
names(calls) [9] <- "arrived_datetime"
names(calls) [10] <- "closed_datetime"


# breaking columns by index
calls <- calls %>%
  mutate(response_time = str_sub(response_datetime,12,23),
         response_date = str_sub(response_datetime,1,11),
         arrived_time = str_sub(arrived_datetime,12,23),
         arrived_date = str_sub(arrived_datetime,1,11),
         closed_time = str_sub(closed_datetime,12,23),
         closed_date = str_sub(closed_datetime,1,11),
         
    response_time = format(parse_date_time(response_time, "I:M:S p"), "%H:%M:%S"),
    arrived_time  = format(parse_date_time(arrived_time, "I:M:S p"), "%H:%M:%S"),
    closed_time   = format(parse_date_time(closed_time, "I:M:S p"), "%H:%M:%S")
  )
head(calls$response_time)
head(calls$response_date)
head(calls$arrived_time)
head(calls$arrived_date)
head(calls$closed_time)
head(calls$closed_date)

head(calls)
```

```{r}
#Unfounded and Gone On Arrival Combined
calls_sorted <- calls %>%
  mutate(
    disposition = case_when(
        `dispositiontext` %in% c("Necessary Action Taken" , "REPORT TO FOLLOW", "NECESSARY ACTION TAKEN", "GONE ON ARRIVAL","VOID", "UNFOUNDED", "REFERRED TO EXTERNAL AGENCY", "Canceled By Complainant") ~ `dispositiontext`,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    disposition_clean = str_trim(toupper(disposition)),
    disposition_clean_combined = case_match(
      disposition_clean,
      c("GONE ON ARRIVAL", "UNFOUNDED") ~ "GONE ON ARRIVAL / UNFOUNDED",
      .default = disposition_clean
      ),
      calls_disposition_necessary_action = as.integer(disposition_clean == "Necessary Action Taken"),
      calls_disposition_report_to_follow = as.integer(disposition_clean == "REPORT TO FOLLOW"),
      calls_disposition_gone_on_arrival_and_unfounded = as.integer(disposition_clean %in% c("GONE ON ARRIVAL", "UNFOUNDED")),
      calls_disposition_void = as.integer(disposition_clean == "VOID"),
      calls_disposition_referred = as.integer(disposition_clean == "REFERRED TO EXTERNAL AGENCY"),
      calls_disposition_canceled = as.integer(disposition_clean == "Canceled By Complainant"),
    priority = parse_number(priority),
    initial_priority = parse_number(initialpriority),
    priority = case_when(
      priority == "3" ~ "Priority 1",
      priority == "2" ~ "Priority 2",
      priority == "1" ~ "Priority 3",
        is.na(priority) & initial_priority == "3" ~ "Priority 1",
        is.na(priority) & initial_priority == "2" ~ "Priority 2",
        is.na(priority) & initial_priority == "1" ~ "Priority 3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    priority_number = as.numeric(str_extract(priority, "\\d+")),
    typetext_clean = str_trim(toupper(typetext)),
    calls_disorder = as.integer(typetext_clean %in% c("DRUNK", "INDECENT BEHAVIOR", "DRUG ACTIVITY", "OBSCENITY, EXPOSING", "HOMELESS", "DISORDERLY CONDUCT", "DRUG VIOLATIONS", "FIGHT", "DOMESTIC DISTURBANCE", "DISTURBANCE (OTHER)")),
    calls_behavior = as.integer(typetext_clean %in% c("SUSPICIOUS VEHICLE", "TRESPASSING", "PROWLER", "SUSPICIOUS PERSON")),
    calls_traffic = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("AUTO ACCIDENT CITY VEHICLE", "ACCIDENT W/INJ - HIT & RUN (PD)", "HIT & RUN WITH INJURIES", "AUTO ACCIDENT WITH I", "ACCIDENT - HIT & RUN", "ACCIDENT - PROPERTY DAMAGE", "AUTO ACCIDENT WITH INJURY", "HIT & RUN", "AUTO ACCIDENT")),
    calls_gun = as.integer(typetext_clean %in% c("SHOTS FIRED", "DISCHARGING FIREARM" )),
         
        calls_robbery = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("ARMED ROBBERY", "SIMPLE ROBBERY, PROPERTY SNATCHING", "SIMPLE ROBBERY", "ARMED ROBBERY WITH GUN")),
        calls_aggravated_assault = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("AGGRAVATED BATTERY DOMESTIC", "ASSAULT W/WEAPON (PD)", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY B", "AGGRAVATED ASSAULT DOMESTIC", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY BY SHOOTING", "AGGRAVATED ASSAULT")),
        calls_burglary = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("AGGRAVATED BURGLARY", "COMMERCIAL BURGLARY", "RESIDENTAL BURGLARY (NOT OCCUPIED AT TIME OF INCIDENT)", "SIMPLE BURGLARY", "RESIDENCE BURGLARY")),
        calls_theft = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("THEFT FROM EXTERIOR", "PICKPOCKET", "THEFT FROM INTERIOR", "BICYCLE THEFT", "SHOPLIFTING", "THEFT")),
        calls_mv_theft = as.integer(typetext_clean  %in% c("THEFT FROM EXTERIOR OF VEHICLE", "BURGLARY FROM VEHICLE", "VEHICLE STOLEN", "AUTO THEFT", "SIMPLE BURGLARY VEHICLE")),
  
            calls_violent = calls_robbery + calls_aggravated_assault,
            calls_property = calls_burglary + calls_theft + calls_mv_theft,
            calls_index = calls_violent + calls_property,
    
              initiator = case_when(
                `selfinitiated` == "Y" ~ "Officer",
                `selfinitiated` == "N" ~ "Citizen",
               is.na(selfinitiated) | `selfinitiated` == "NA" ~ "N/A",
                TRUE ~ NA_character_
              ), 
    datetime = lubridate::parse_date_time(
  response_datetime,
  orders = c("mdy_IMSp", "mdy_HMS", "ymd_HMS", "mdy_HM")
),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    year = year(datetime),
    month = lubridate::floor_date(datetime, "month"),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime)
              )  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(minute), !is.na(initiator), !is.na(hour), !is.na(day_of_week), !is.na(date), !is.na(month))
```

```{r, fig.width = 20}
#hr of day type
by_hour_type <- bind_rows(
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(hour = hour) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
)

# graphed distribution of 911 times by hour
ggplot(by_hour_type, aes(hour, n, color = type)) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 4)) +
  labs(title = "New Orleans 911 Times by Hour of the Day and Call Type", x = "Hour", y = "Calls")+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, fig.width = 20}
#hr of day type initator
by_hour_type <- bind_rows(
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(hour = hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
) %>%
  filter(initiator %in% c("Citizen", "Officer"))

# graphed distribution of 911 times by hour
by_hour_type_proportional <- by_hour_type %>%
  group_by(initiator, type) %>%
  mutate(proportional = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(by_hour_type_proportional, aes(hour, proportional, color = initiator, group = initiator)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .8) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 3)) +
  labs(title = "New Orleans 911 Times by Hour of the Day, Call Type, and Initiator", x = "Hour", y = "Calls") + 
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, fig.width = 20}
#time diff
time_differences <- calls_sorted %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    time_arrive = as.numeric(interval(mdy_hms(response_datetime), mdy_hms(arrived_datetime)) / minutes(1)),
    time_on_scene = as.numeric(interval(mdy_hms(arrived_datetime), mdy_hms(closed_datetime)) / minutes(1)),
    time_total = as.numeric(interval(mdy_hms(response_datetime), mdy_hms(closed_datetime)) / minutes(1))
  )


time_differences_all <- bind_rows(
  time_differences %>%
    select(time_arrive, time_on_scene, time_total) %>%
    mutate(type = "All Calls")
)

time_differences_all %>%
  filter(time_arrive >= 0, time_arrive <= 120, time_on_scene >= 0, time_on_scene <= 120, time_total >= 0, time_total <= 120) %>%
  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(aes(time_arrive, fill = "Time to Arrive"), color = "green", alpha = .4, binwidth = 5) +
    geom_histogram(aes(time_on_scene, fill = "Time on Scene"), color = "red", alpha = .4, binwidth = 5) +
    geom_histogram(aes(time_total, fill = "Total Time"), color = "blue", alpha = .4, binwidth = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "New Orleans 911 Call Time Differences", x = "Minutes", y = "Number of Calls", fill = "Time Difference")

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#sunlight data


df_dates <- expand.grid(year = 2011:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>% 

  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>% 

  mutate(date = ymd(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% 

  arrange(date) 

 df_dates

#Get suntime data 


df_sun <- df_dates %>% 

  mutate(lat =  29.9511,  

         lon = -90.0715) %>% 

  getSunlightTimes(data = ., tz = "America/Chicago", keep = c("dawn", "sunrise", "sunset", "dusk", "night")) %>% 

  rename_all(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    dawn = hour(dawn) + minute(dawn) / 60,
    sunrise = hour(sunrise) + minute(sunrise) / 60,
    sunset = hour(sunset) + minute(sunset) / 60,
    dusk = hour(dusk) + minute(dusk) / 60,
    night = hour(night) + minute(night) / 60
  )

df_sun
```

```{r}
#spring RD (change disposition from raw count of crimes to proportion)
plottheme <- theme( 
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12), 
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"), 
  panel.background = element_blank(),  
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
  legend.key = element_rect(colour = "transparent", fill = "transparent"), 
  legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), 
  legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.position = "none", 
  rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )


dst_dates <- tibble(
  year = 2011:2024,
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2011-03-13", "2012-03-11", "2013-03-10", "2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2011-11-06", "2012-11-04", "2013-11-03", "2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)


calls_night <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    time_parsed = strptime(response_time, format = "%H:%M:%S"),
    hour_dec = hour(time_parsed) + minute(time_parsed) / 60 + second(time_parsed) / 3600
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_sun, by = "date") %>%
  filter(hour_dec >= sunset & hour_dec < night)

calls_sorted_night <- calls_night %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(starts_with("calls_disposition"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE) / n()),
    calls_average_priority = mean(priority_number, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dst_rd_spring <- calls_sorted_night %>%
  mutate( 
    year = year(date)
    ) %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(days_until_spring = as.integer(date - dst_spring)) %>%
  filter(days_until_spring %in% -21:21) %>%
  mutate(
    dst_on = if_else(days_until_spring >= 0, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  group_by(days_until_spring, dst_on) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(starts_with("calls_disposition"), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calls_average_priority = mean(calls_average_priority, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

vnames <- dst_rd_spring %>% select(starts_with("calls_")) %>% names()


for(X in vnames){ 

  f1 <- as.formula(paste0(X, "~ poly(days_until_spring, 2)")) 
  sub_no  <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "no")
  sub_yes <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "yes")

  if(length(unique(sub_no$days_until_spring)) < 3 | length(unique(sub_yes$days_until_spring)) < 3) next

  lm1 <- lm(f1, data = sub_no)
  lm2 <- lm(f1, data = sub_yes)
  pred1 <- predict(lm1, newdata = sub_no, se = TRUE)
  pred2 <- predict(lm2, newdata = sub_yes, se = TRUE)

  dst_rd_spring_plot <- bind_rows(sub_no, sub_yes) %>%
    mutate(pred = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit), 
           upper = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) - qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit), 
           lower = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) + qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit)) 

  clean_title <- X %>% 
    str_replace("calls_", "") %>% 
    str_replace("_", " ") %>% 
    str_to_title()
  
  ylabel <- ifelse(str_detect(X, "clearedrate"), "Clearance rate", "Crimes") 
  
p <- ggplot(dst_rd_spring_plot, aes(x = days_until_spring, y = .data[[X]])) + 
    geom_point(aes(group = dst_on), size = 3, color = "royalblue", shape = 1) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = pred, group = dst_on)) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = upper, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_line(aes(y = lower, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +  
    labs(title = paste("New Orleans 911 RD:", clean_title), 
         x = "Days until Spring DST starts", 
         y = ylabel)
print(p)
}

```
